_readme: Silhouettes listed in 'glb' load assets/geo/<key>.glb and assets/masks/<key>.png instead of the procedural placeholder. Drop the two files in, add the key here, reload. Keys: ankle crew knee toe baby slipper dress novelty. Export convention (after the Blender UV pass, DESIGN 13.3): sock laid flat in the XZ plane, thickness along +Y, cuff toward -X, foot turning toward +Z, meters, origin anywhere (the loader recentres and rescales to the silhouette's size in src/silhouettes.js). UV: U around the tube (0 at the heel edge), V cuff (0) to toe (1). Mask PNG: R heel, G toe, B cuff.
